title: Only the merge tool may post a review record
why: Third incident of a hand-written review record: lane notes-fix-reverify-large on #1494, #1506, #1597, #1667 and #1668, after #1512 and #1472.
note: Fix: the guard refuses `gh pr comment` or `gh api …/comments` whose body has the review-record header, unless the merge tool sends it. The coordinator reverses its earlier `Fix: none` (its own pick, 18:42 CST Nov 7, can be undone). The five PRs wait for #1634 and records re-posted from the tool. Same post point as step review-record-post-parses (lane session_013NEJL1rKuNDSwMxwArjXHb), which checks that a posted record parses: one guard home for both. Coordinator 18:43 CST: stacked on #1601 (review-record-from-render); it adds the marker only the tool writes, not a second guard. 18:45 CST: stacked on #1671, not #1601 directly. Coordinator 18:50 CST: also covers `--review-record` refusing PASS unless `--lane-lint` passes on the head (incident #1502). Coordinator 20:40 CST Nov 7: #1634 gets one more Windows-only fix try (coordinator pick a); a third red drops it.
